hypothesis: The active linear iteration cap materially limits nonlinear convergence. This is a hypothesis, not an established cause.

thresholds_unchanged.note: Numerical/engineering screens chosen before runs; NASA +/-0.02 is measurement uncertainty, not a universal CFD pass criterion.

diagnostic_effect_rule.native_outcome_required: Both native exits zero and matched complete checkpoints at iteration999
diagnostic_effect_rule.interpretation: A preselected diagnostic effect size, not a physical acceptance threshold or a statistical confidence level.
diagnostic_effect_rule.insufficient_effect_action: Reject the cap increase as an evidenced cure; do not sweep more caps.
diagnostic_effect_rule.cost: Report both equal nonlinear iteration counts and observed time/linear work; single-order timing is not a hardware benchmark.

scope: Numerical mechanism discrimination on one fixed M6 mesh; no new mesh independence, physical validation, or LLM-behaviour evaluation.
plan_after: Compare coupled residuals and force windows; if iteration error remains, do not interpret spatial indicators as quantified discretization error.
